description: Make a music track with ElevenLabs Music: a song, a score, a background bed. Either describe the whole track in prompt (genre, mood, instruments, tempo, era, how it builds) or pass a plan you got from plan_music and edited section by section. seconds sets the length, 3 to 600 (default 30). instrumental true keeps every voice out. HOUSE RULE: only put music on a job when the customer actually asked for music; never add a bed because it feels empty, and when music is asked for keep it to what they named. This tool is NOT for sound effects: whooshes, impacts, chimes, risers, foley and ambiences are generate_sound_effect. Billed per 10 seconds (a token quote applies) and the file is saved to your library. Returns audio_url, duration_seconds and generation_id.

instrumental.description: Optional. true makes a track with no singing and no voices at all.

plan.description: Optional. The composition plan object plan_music returned, with its sections edited however you like. When this is sent the plan decides the structure and the length.

prompt.description: The whole track in plain words, for example "driving hard rock instrumental, live drums, dirty guitars, 140 bpm, builds to a big last chorus". Leave out when you are passing an edited plan.

seconds.description: Optional length in seconds, 3 to 600. Default 30. Ignored when a plan is sent, because the plan carries its own section lengths.

name: generate_music
title: Generate Music
